# Summary of Work Completed

## What's Done

### R1 - CLI Python-Full Support
- Modified `glom/cli.py` `mw_get_target` middleware to handle `--spec-format python-full`
- Uses `eval()` with a controlled namespace exposing glom types (T, S, Path, Spec, Coalesce, Check, Assign, Auto, Fill, Iter, Let, Invoke)
- Distinguishes from regular 'python' format which uses `ast.literal_eval()`

### R2 - Expose New Names as Public API
- Added `Auto`, `Fill`, `Iter`, `Let` classes to `glom/core.py`
- Added `ROOT` sentinel object to `glom/core.py`
- Exported all five from `glom/__init__.py`

### R3 - Invoke Class and Constants Module
- Added `Invoke` class to `glom/core.py` with `glomit()` method and `__repr__`
- Created `glom/constants.py` module exporting RAISE, _MISSING, SKIP, STOP, OMIT
- Maintained backward compatibility via `consts` dict alias
- Exported `constants` submodule from `glom/__init__.py`

### R4 - Fill __repr__
- Implemented `__repr__` returning `Fill(%r, fill_value=%r)` format

### R5 - Assign __repr__
- Implemented `__repr__` in `glom/mutation.py` `Assign` class
- Returns readable string with path, value, and optional missing argument

### R6 - Coalesce __repr__
- Implemented `__repr__` in `Coalesce` class
- Handles single vs multiple subspecs, plus default/skip/skip_exc kwargs

### R7 - All Public Specifiers Have __repr__
- **Fixed bug** in `Check.__repr__`: changed `self.type` → `self.types` and `self.equal_to` → proper attributes
- Verified all other specifiers (Call, Inspect, Literal, etc.) already had `__repr__` methods
- All new specifiers (Auto, Fill, Iter, Let, Invoke) include `__repr__`

### Tests
- 72/73 tests pass (1 deselected due to missing PyYAML dependency - pre-existing issue)
- No regressions introduced
